0022600137.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-3, on a two-game losing streak) host the New York Knicks (1-3, winners of their last game) in the Bulls' fifth game of the season. Chicago is 4th in the Central and 11th in the East, 2 games back, while New York is 4th in the Atlantic, also 2 games back, and 12th in the East. Chicago is without Nic Claxton (out, hamstring) and Patrick Williams (out, groin soreness), and Tobe Awaka is day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision, while New York is missing Jose Alvarado (out, ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Bulls lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 136-96 loss in New York on April 3, 2026.
